_comment: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE PERSONA - safe to commit. Every employer, project, date and number below is invented and internally consistent with profile.yml and gaps.md in this folder. Pairs with the Week 3 mode recipes/cases/2026fa/AravindB98-young-startup-sponsor-triage.md.
attestation_note: Example data. The corrections below are the kinds of error the setup exercise expects: a metric on the resume that the project's own README contradicts, a title the offer letter does not support, a 'submitted' paper that had already been rejected, and a skills block longer than the evidence.

work_authorization.post_graduation_authorization: OPT (12 months) to be applied for; EAD not yet issued
work_authorization.stem_opt_extension: uncertain: CIP code not yet confirmed
work_authorization.attestation_correction: The resume says nothing about authorization; the import left this null and the scorer reads a blank as 'does not need sponsorship'. Filled in by the owner.

availability.attestation_correction: Import carried a May to December 2026 co-op window from an old application. Replaced with the actual full-time start.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built document-ingestion pipelines in Python for insurance claims; cut manual review time by about a third (team estimate, no written measurement).
Maintained a FastAPI service with PostgreSQL; on a two-person rotation for production alerts.
experience.attestation_correction: Original draft said 'Senior Software Engineer'. The offer letter says 'Software Engineer'; corrected.

experience.title: Data Engineering Intern
bullets: Wrote Airflow jobs that loaded shipment events into a reporting warehouse.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant, graduate course on generative AI
bullets: Weekly office hours; grading of prompt-engineering assignments.

projects.name: ledgerlint
projects.description: Multi-agent LLM reviewer for accounting scripts: three LangGraph agents, a 24-rule deterministic pre-pass, SARIF output, Docker image, 28 unit tests.
projects.evaluation_record: A 12-sample toy suite and a 20-sample paired suite, each run once. The resume bullet 'cut false positive rate by 86%' is FP/(FP+TP) from the better of two runs; the README now labels it a false discovery rate and the resume line must change.
projects.attestation_correction: Resume metric corrected: false discovery rate from one run, not a false positive rate.
projects.verify_status: confirmed by owner, not by any script

projects.name: ward-notes
projects.description: RAG over de-identified discharge summaries with a ChromaDB store and an LLM summariser.
projects.attestation_correction: Original draft said 'led a team of three'. Corrected: one of three, owned the retrieval layer.

publications.title: Replay Testing for Agent Graphs: A Design Note
publications.peer_review_status: submitted to a workshop and rejected; under revision
publications.attestation_correction: Import recorded 'submitted', which reads as pending. It is not pending.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer, Associate
certifications.note: Listed only so gaps.md can close it; must not appear on a resume until issued.

skills.agent_note: familiar_with_not_shipped is honest: listed nowhere as production experience.
